profile_text.body:
Baidu is a Chinese technology company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Beijing. It is publicly traded under the ticker BIDU (CIK 0001329099). The company's AI work is centered on its ERNIE family of models, which it develops and publishes through ernie.baidu.com.

On the generative AI side, Baidu describes ERNIE 5.0 as a 2.4 trillion-parameter unified multimodal model trained from scratch, integrating text, image, video, and audio into a single autoregressive framework. The company also offers ERNIE-Image, a text-to-image generation model built on a single-stream Diffusion Transformer architecture with 8 billion DiT parameters, and PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, a document understanding model the company says achieves 94.5% accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.5. ERNIE is tracked on this site under the Chinese Foundation Models category, with a note that cross-border data review is advised for users outside China.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for Baidu at this time.
